title: Cloud Mail (Fairmail) — Import Configs
description: Single-file provisioning contract consumed by the mail fork's 'Import Configs' action. One JSON provisions IMAP/SMTP accounts, JMAP accounts, and RSS feed channels in one shot. SECRET-SAFE: this file carries NO passwords or tokens — credentials are entered at import time (or obtained via OAuth/bearer). Never commit a populated file containing secrets.

version.description: Contract version. Bump on breaking shape changes.

_credentials.description: Documentation marker: credentials are prompted at import time and never stored in this file (Pillar 7).

imap_smtp.description: Classic IMAP-receive + SMTP-send accounts. Maps to a FairEmail EntityAccount(protocol=IMAP) + EntityIdentity.

uuid.description: Stable id for idempotent re-import (dedupe key).

jmap.description: JMAP accounts (RFC 8620/8621) against a JMAP session endpoint. Maps to a FairEmail EntityAccount(protocol=JMAP) added by the JMAP-transport patches.

jmap_host.description: JMAP session host (TLS). Caddy L4 demuxes jmap. to Stalwart.

auth.description: Credential kind prompted at import time.

rss.description: RSS/Atom feed channels. Each maps to a local feed folder under the synthetic RSS account; items render as messages (RSS-reader patches).

title.description: Display name of the feed (folder name).

folder.description: Optional folder name override (defaults to title).

poll_interval_hours.description: Periodic fetch cadence; the RSS worker uses the max of all feeds.
